summary: 21Shares Dogecoin ETF filed an 8-K reporting the termination of a material definitive agreement — the Pricing Benchmark Licensing Agreement with CF Benchmarks Ltd., effective August 31, 2026. The sponsor elected to terminate in connection with transitioning to a new benchmark provider, FTSE International Limited, with a new license expected around August 24, 2026. No financial terms, premiums, or shareholder impact were disclosed. This is a routine operational change of index provider, not a special situation. What to watch: ensure seamless transition of NAV calculation.
